description_for_human: Supplier status, overdue items and decisions waiting, from the Innovation Hub.
description_for_model: Use this when the user asks about supplier, vendor or partner companies the innovation team is exploring, about supplier meetings, emails, follow-ups or pilots, about anything overdue, late or slipping, or about decisions waiting (business cases, pilot decisions, innovation reviews). listCompanies finds companies; getCompanyStatus gives one company's details; listOverdue lists what is late; listDecisionsNeeded lists decisions waiting and who makes them.

functions.name: listCompanies
functions.description: List supplier companies, optionally filtered by part of the name, with stage, last contact, next meeting and number of open actions.

functions.name: getCompanyStatus
functions.description: Everything recorded about one company by its id (CO-0001): stage, requests, official contacts, recent emails, meetings with summaries, open actions with owners and due dates, research facts and the team's notes.

instructions: Only use facts present in the JSON response.
If a field is empty or missing, say it is not recorded rather than guessing.
Owners shown as UNASSIGNED have no owner yet: point that out.

functions.name: listOverdue
functions.description: Everything overdue or slipping: overdue actions with owners, supplier emails with no reply past the follow-up date, meetings held without notes, pilots past their end date, benefit check-ins due. Pass owner to narrow to one person.

instructions: List the most late items first, with owner, how many days late and the request number.
Only use items in the response. If the list is empty, say nothing is overdue.
To mark something done, tell the user to open it in the Innovation Hub.

functions.name: listDecisionsNeeded
functions.description: Decisions waiting on people: business cases awaiting management approval, evaluated pilots waiting for a scale/extend/revise/stop decision, and employee-requested innovation reviews. Each says who decides and how long it has waited.

instructions: Group by who decides (Management, Innovation team) and show the longest waiting first.
Include the detail given (verdict, payback or recommendation) without adding to it.
Decisions are made in the Innovation Hub; Copilot can't approve or decide.
